en.title: One week, 167,100 km² more white ground in Sweden
en.description: One week, 167,100 km² more white ground in Sweden. Snow cover, new snow, resorts and the days ahead in Sweden on 16 November.
en.lede: Seven days ago about 89,890 km² of high ground was white in Sweden; today it is 256,990 km², a gain of 167,100 km².

p: The new white ground is mostly in the middle heights, where a single cold spell can turn grass into a usable base.
Snow covers roughly 256,990 km² in Sweden on 16 November, about the same as yesterday. That is 79 % of the high ground we map in Sweden.
Last week's 89,890 km² has grown by 167,100 km². Even the lowest ground is mostly white.
The Hemavan fjells got the most fresh snow over three days, up to 9 cm.
In the past day, up to 3 cm was added.
At least 5 cm fell over some 34,550 km².
At the top of the list, Abisko reports 129 cm.
Close behind: Björkliden (129 cm), Huså (33 cm), Almåsa (31 cm) and Brantberget (31 cm).
Abisko picked up 3 cm in the last three days and could add 12 cm by Thursday 19 November.
At Björkliden: 3 cm of fresh snow over three days, 12 cm more expected by Thursday 19 November.
Count 59 white resorts out of 75 in Sweden today.

The rest of the shortlist: Huså: 33 cm on top, 4 cm in three days, 3 cm expected; Almåsa: 31 cm on top, 3 cm in three days, 3 cm expected; Brantberget: 31 cm on top, 0 cm in three days, 7 cm expected.
Snow is in the forecast: up to 15 cm by the end of the third day, up to 18 cm within seven days.
Wednesday 18 November stands out, with up to 11 cm in a day.
The second week adds up to 15 cm where it snows most.

Snow depth on the ground, height by height: 0-500 m: on average 8 cm (71 % of the ground white); 500-1,000 m: on average 14 cm (100 % of the ground white); 1,000-1,500 m: on average 42 cm (100 % of the ground white); 1,500-2,000 m: on average 68 cm (100 % of the ground white).

Resort by resort, today against a normal 16 November: Abisko: 32 cm at about 652 m, against 27 cm in a normal year; Björkliden: 46 cm at about 678 m, against 44 cm in a normal year; Huså: 19 cm at about 548 m, against 18 cm in a normal year; Almåsa: 23 cm at about 560 m, against 16 cm in a normal year.
4 of these 4 resorts are above their usual depth for the date.
These depths are for one height on each mountain, below the top, so they read lower than the upper-slope numbers further down.
In past winters the best snow at Abisko usually came late March / early April.

For comparison, the neighbours on the same day: Norway: 87 % white, deepest Riksgränsen with 173 cm, up to 39 cm in the week ahead; Finland: 52 % white, deepest Kallin with 23 cm, up to 19 cm in the week ahead.

sections.h: Planning a day on the snow
p: Above 500 m the ground is almost fully white (100 % covered), so runs up there have a continuous base.
Between 0 m and 500 m the cover is patchy, about 71 % white: expect grass and stones between the snow.
If you can choose the day, go after Wednesday 18 November: the fresh snow then has time to settle and the roads to be cleared.
The white area is growing, so more lifts and runs can open in the coming days if the cold holds.
With more snow in the forecast, the next days should improve things further.

advice: Early-season snow is thin over rocks: ski the groomed runs first.
Roads to the higher resorts may need winter tyres or chains.
Check the resort's own lift status before you travel.

sv.title: Hur mycket snö finns det i Sverige? Snötäcke och prognos, 16 november 2026
sv.description: Snö i Sverige 16 november: snötäcke, nysnö, snödjup efter höjd, de närmaste dagarna och de bästa skidorterna.
sv.lede: Snötäcket i Sverige sträcker sig över omkring 256 990 km² (måndag 16 november). Ytan är nästan densamma som i går.

p: Jämfört med 89 890 km² för sju dagar sedan är det 167 100 km² mer. Snön ligger ända ner till låglandet och kusten.

Snödjupet beror på höjden: 0–500 m: i snitt 8 cm (71 % snötäckt); 500–1 000 m: i snitt 14 cm (100 % snötäckt); 1 000–1 500 m: i snitt 42 cm (100 % snötäckt); 1 500–2 000 m: i snitt 68 cm (100 % snötäckt).
Under tre dygn föll mest nysnö här: Hemavanfjällen (upp till 9 cm).
Bara det senaste dygnet föll upp till 3 cm.
Minst 5 cm nysnö täcker omkring 34 550 km².
Den vita ytan växer, och håller kylan i sig kan fler liftar öppna.
Veckan kan ge upp till 18 cm, varav upp till 15 cm de närmaste tre dagarna.
Den snörikaste dagen: onsdag, 18 november, upp till 11 cm.
Längre fram, dag 8–14, kan de snörikaste sluttningarna få upp till 15 cm till.
Mest snö i de övre backarna: Abisko, 129 cm.
Skidorter med snö i de övre backarna: 59 av 75.
Därefter: Björkliden (129 cm), Huså (33 cm), Almåsa (31 cm) och Brantberget (31 cm).
Abisko: 3 cm nysnö på tre dagar och upp till 12 cm till före torsdag, 19 november.

advice: Tidigt på säsongen är snön tunn över stenarna: håll dig i preparerade backar.
